$comment: Dated exceptions for the CI npm audit gate (scripts/verify-npm-audit.mjs). Each entry silences exactly one advisory id until its expiry date; after that CI fails again. Never add an entry without a recorded founder approval.

exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs (<= 4.0.7). No patched version is published (npm latest is 4.0.7 on 2026-11-17).
exceptions.evidence: picomatch is reached only through build tooling: vite, tinyglobby/fdir, unplugin and @tanstack/start-plugin-core (npm ls picomatch, 2026-11-17). No application source imports it (only vite.config.ts uses vite). Production builds (npm run build, and VERCEL=1 npm run build producing .vercel/output) contain no picomatch, tinyglobby or fdir code. Glob patterns come from build configuration, never from user input.
exceptions.approval: Muhammad Sheriff Yusuf-Wasili (founder), t215u, 2026-11-17 18:46 WAT: 'Execute it toward the best recommended move' (option b: narrow, dated exception).
